bosses.name: Highlord Omokk
bosses.general: Big ogre with ogre guards: Cleave and Knock Away.
bosses.tank: Face him away and grab his guards.

bosses.name: Shadow Hunter Vosh'gajin
bosses.general: Troll witch doctor: Hex, Curse of Blood and Cleave.
bosses.healer: Dispel the hex and the curse.

bosses.name: War Master Voone
bosses.general: Throws axes, Mortal Strike, Cleave, Snap Kick.
bosses.tank: Face him away; Mortal Strike cuts your healing.
bosses.healer: Heal ahead of the mortal strikes.

bosses.name: Mother Smolderweb
bosses.general: Spider queen: Crystallize stuns, poison bites.

bosses.name: Urok Doomhowl
bosses.general: Called with Omokk's head on the pike: ogre waves first, then Urok.
bosses.tank: Hold the ogres as they come, then Urok.

bosses.name: Quartermaster Zigris
bosses.general: Shoots, nets and drinks healing potions.

bosses.name: Halycon
bosses.general: Big worg: Rend and Thrash. When she dies, Gizrul comes running.
bosses.tank: Stay ready to pick up Gizrul.

bosses.name: Gizrul the Slavener
bosses.general: Comes after Halycon: Fatal Bite and Frenzy.
bosses.tank: Use a cooldown in his frenzy.
bosses.healer: Heavy damage on the tank in the frenzy.

bosses.name: Overlord Wyrmthalak
bosses.general: Cleave, Demoralizing Shout; at half health he calls two Bloodaxe Veterans.
bosses.tank: Face him away; grab the veterans.
bosses.healer: Three on the tank at the end.
bosses.dps: Veterans or crowd control them, then Wyrmthalak.
